note: The case that motivated the profile: the Turkish fold gives 'apı', silently mangling English acronyms.
Turkish fold gives 'ı/o'. Slash is left to the FTS5 tokenizer, not the normalizer.
English lowercases I to i. Turkish would give 'ıstanbul' — the two profiles must disagree here.
LENGTH INVARIANT: bare lowercase yields 'i̇stanbul' (9 units for 8 in). U+0130 is folded explicitly first.
Minimal case for the length invariant: 1 char in, 1 char out.
Only the _for_fts variant collapses whitespace; the plain form is length-preserving.
Not uppercased to SS: lowercase of ß is ß, so length is preserved.
Final sigma handling differs between engines; both Python and JS give σ here, and length is stable.
Already-lowercase dotless ı is left alone: the English profile never maps I to ı, and never maps ı back.
